complete_examples.text: The computational approach for vehicle–track interactions has been explored over decades.
Apart from the modeling of vehicle–track interactions and aerodynamic characteristics, an inevitable work is to couple the wind effects and the vehicle–track interactions.
Thus, it is far more accurate and reliable to evaluate the critical factors dominating the vehicle–track interactions.
Thus in vehicle–track interactions, the researches involving with track irregularities should be paid special attention.
Except for the importance of modelling vehicle–track interactions, another necessity considered is the system excitation inputs.

For constructing the vehicle–track coupling interactions in 3-D space, the work, elastic strain, and potential energy produced in the vehicle–track interactions should be further presented except the work done by the wheel/rail related forces.
